_comment: Description of each phenotype table, keyed by table (schema_name in bids_field_organization.csv). Names follow bridge2ai-redcap docs/REDCap/Instruments.md; REDCap has no form descriptions of its own.

tables.acoustic_task: Acoustic tasks administered in each session (REDCap form `acoustic_task`).
tables.amyotrophic_lateral_sclerosis: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) diagnosis form (REDCap form `d_neuro_amyotrophic_lateral_sclerosis_als`).
tables.cognitive_impairment: Alzheimer's, MCI, and Other Dementias diagnosis form (REDCap form `d_neuro_alzheimers_disease_mild_cognitive_impairme`).
tables.copd_and_asthma: COPD and Asthma diagnosis form (REDCap form `d_resp_copd_and_asthma`).
tables.depression: Depression / Major Depressive Disorder diagnosis form (REDCap form `d_mood_depression_or_major_depressive_disorder`).
tables.enrollment: Self-reported conditions from the enrollment form, and Prolific information (REDCap forms `enrollment_form`, `prolific_information`).
tables.glottic_insufficiency: Glottic Insufficiency / Presbyphonia diagnosis form (REDCap form `d_voice_glottic_insufficiency_presbyphonia`).
tables.harvard_sentences: Harvard Sentences acoustic task details (REDCap form `q_generic_harvard_sentences`).
tables.muscle_tension_dysphonia: Muscle Tension Dysphonia (MTD) diagnosis form (REDCap form `d_voice_muscle_tension_dysphonia_mtd`).
tables.productive_vocabulary: Productive Vocabulary acoustic task details (REDCap form `q_neuro_productive_vocabulary`).
tables.psychiatric_history: Participant History questionnaire (REDCap form `q_mood_participant_history`). Retired questionnaire: no longer collected.
tables.ptsd_adult: PTSD Adult questionnaire (REDCap form `q_mood_ptsd_adult`). Retired questionnaire: no longer collected.
tables.random_item_generation: Random Item Generation acoustic task details (REDCap form `q_neuro_random_item_generation`).
tables.recording: Audio recordings and their metadata (REDCap form `recording`).
tables.stroop: Word-Color Stroop acoustic task details (REDCap form `q_neuro_wordcolor_stroop`).
tables.unexplained_chronic_cough: Unexplained Chronic Cough diagnosis form (REDCap form `d_resp_unexplained_chronic_cough`).
tables.unilateral_vocal_fold_paralysis: Unilateral Vocal Fold Paralysis diagnosis form (REDCap form `d_voice_unilateral_vocal_fold_paralysis`).
tables.winograd: Winograd Schemas questionnaire (REDCap form `q_neuro_winograd_schemas`). Retired questionnaire: no longer collected.
